notes:
A new look for the whole window.
- Tabs sit above the toolbar, and the selected tab runs straight into it
- The toolbar and the empty tab are frosted glass too
- Bookmarks on the empty tab show their names
- Everything feels faster and easier to read
- A new app icon and install window

The first beta of Koi.
- The window is frosted glass, calm and right at home on macOS
- Horizontal tabs are back, in a toolbar designed to take less of your screen and still feel roomy
- Connecting an agent takes a click, and it works in its own folder while you keep browsing
- Developer Mode gives web developers extra tools and easier access to the usual ones
- Built on Firefox, so your passwords, bookmarks and extensions carry over when you sign in
- Drag one tab onto another to make a folder
- ⇧⌘E shows every open tab at once
- Private windows are violet
- No telemetry, nothing to learn
- Koi updates itself
Requires a Mac with Apple silicon.
